title: Dynamic trivia distracters in daily country solution blog
body:
DAILY BLOG TRIVIA DISTRACTER FIX
- Replaced the hardcoded 'It has a coastline on the Mediterranean Sea' trivia distracter with geographically validated, mutually exclusive false statements based on continent and country facts.
- Solved the contradiction on Mediterranean countries (such as Tunisia, Spain, France, Italy, Greece, Cyprus, Morocco, and Egypt) where the distracter was factually true but struck through as incorrect.
- Shuffled trivia options deterministically based on country and puzzle ID, ensuring answers alternate naturally without UI shift.
- Added multilingual support for English and Polish memory check feedback.
